title: Research data supporting 'EEG recording during playing MOBA game'
description: This dataset comprises resting-state (eyes closed and eyes open) and task-based EEG recordings collected from 23 participants while playing a real multiplayer online battle arena (MOBA) video game. EEG data were collected using a 64-channel Neuroscan system, capturing neural correlates of in-game events such as kills, deaths, game start, victory, and failure. The data collection took place between April and July 2023, and is intended to support research on the neurophysiological responses associated with competitive video gaming.
methods_description: EEG data were recorded using a Neuroscan system with 64 electrodes at a sampling frequency of 1000Hz. Event markers were used to label in-game events including kills (13), deaths (14), game start (66), game failure (444), and game victory (666).
